mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate crossing above 6% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as elevated labor market stress reduces investor confidence and equity valuations.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur despite UNRATE exceeding 6.0% in the same period, or t-test p-value > 0.05 in such events.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through increased market optimism.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) coupled with high supply growth (INDPRO) amplify market optimism, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 0.05 and INDPRO > 104.1152 in the same period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in HOUST (demand) above 956.0 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as increased demand anticipation drives short-term gains.
failure_condition: Negative 5-day returns occur despite HOUST exceeding 956.0 in the same period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monetary easing (FEDFUNDS < 0.05) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) creates a dual signal of accommodative policy and labor market stability, driving positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both FEDFUNDS < 0.05 and UNRATE < 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consistently high supply growth (INDPRO > 104.1152) over time predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as excess capacity reduces inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when INDPRO exceeds 104.1152 in the same period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS surpassing 140,000 employment (labor demand) while UNRATE remains below 5.0% triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as labor market strength supports equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 140000 in 1 month AND UNRATE < 5.0%
failure_condition: Negative 5-day returns occur despite PAYEMS > 140000 and UNRATE < 5.0% in the same period (t-test p > 0.05).
